Instant tailor free · offline

Apply kit

          
Click to copy, then paste into the employer's application form. Faster than retyping, and safer than auto-apply bots, which can get your account flagged.

          

        

        

          
1-click autofill browser extension

          
On an employer's application form (Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Teamtailor, SmartRecruiters, Personio and more), click the ChaLLengErs extension → Autofill this application. It fills your name, contact details and links, pastes your cover letter and attaches your tailored CV as a PDF. You check everything and click Submit yourself, so applications stay accurate and your accounts stay safe.
